title: Diddy's Family Spotted Outside Courthouse After Verdict - Photos Video That Sparked Buzz - NewsBreak
text: The 55-year-old rapper's family drew attention after the verdict, as their reaction outside the courthouse struck a tone some found unexpectedly upbeat. On July 2, 2025, the jury delivered its verdict in Sean "Diddy" Combs' federal trial, drawing swift public attention — not only to the outcome but also to his family's behavior. Jurors acquitted Combs of the most serious charges, including racketeering conspiracy and sex trafficking by force, fraud, or coercion. However, they found him guilty of two lesser counts involving the transportation of individuals to engage in prostitution. The decision came after three days of deliberation following a seven-week trial that featured graphic and disturbing testimony. Despite avoiding the most severe penalties, Combs was denied bail after U.S. District Judge Arun Subramanian ruled that he posed a danger to the public. Inside the courtroom, Combs dropped to his knees in prayer as the verdict was read. His family clapped softly in the background. As he exited, he told them, "Thank you, love you." Outside, his family smiled and embraced. Photos and videos of the moment quickly circulated online, sparking backlash over their response to the serious charges. "Why are they smiling!" a netizen said . Another wrote , "His mother & children should be humiliated, not out there smiling!" A third commented , "This is sickening." Another asked , "Why are his daughters smiling 😟 their dad was denied bail." This story is developing. Please stay tuned.
